sources.title: csebuetnlp/banglabert · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains the pretrained discriminator checkpoint of the model BanglaBERT. This is an ELECTRA discriminator model pretrained with the Replaced Token Detection (RTD) objective. Finetuned models using this checkpoint achieve state-of-the-art results on many of the NLP tasks in bengali.

sources.title: BanglaBERT: Bangla-Specific NLP Model
sources.snippet: BanglaBERT is a Bangla-specific pretrained language model using ELECTRA pretraining, a dedicated tokenizer, and a curated corpus to improve NLP tasks. It standardizes evaluation in Bangla NLP with the unified BLUB benchmark and supports bilingual transfer via BanglishBERT for zero-shot applications.
